text_block_list.name: Fusaichi Pandora
text_block_list.text: Hah! Haa! Haa! Haa!

text_block_list.name: Fusaichi Pandora
text_block_list.text:
(My legs hurt! My lungs are bursting! My body's at its limit!
But, but, but, but why!?)

text_block_list.name: Fusaichi Pandora
text_block_list.text: (This is soooo much fun!!)

text_block_list.name: Fusaichi Pandora
text_block_list.text:
—For... Ai's sakeeee!!
Hyyaaaaaaaaaaaah!!

text_block_list.name: Fusaichi Pandora
text_block_list.text: Hell yeah, FIRST PLAAAAAACE!!

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text: (WOOOOOO!!)

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Fusaichi Pandora's race produced a huge
surge of shock and cheers. And then—

text_block_list.name: Almond Eye
text_block_list.text:
Fufu.
So that's what you're like when you get serious, Pandora.

text_block_list.name: Almond Eye
text_block_list.text:
I knew she was good, but that was magnificent.
I can't afford to lose either!

text_block_list.name: Almond Eye
text_block_list.text: I'm going to train even more from now on and get so, so much stronger!

text_block_list.name: Fusaichi Pandora
text_block_list.text:
Woohoo, yaaay~~☆
I'm happy, happy, so super happy~!

text_block_list.name: Fusaichi Pandora
text_block_list.text: (Still, I was seriously in top shape~. Mind and body were totally on cloud nine, feel like I could seriously do anything~~!)

text_block_list.name: Fusaichi Pandora
text_block_list.text: *Sigh*... ...Aha.

text_block_list.name: Fusaichi Pandora
text_block_list.text: (It feels... so strange. Just the other day, I was at rock bottom.)

text_block_list.name: Fusaichi Pandora
text_block_list.text: (As I thought, this is——)

text_block_list.name: Fusaichi Pandora
text_block_list.text: She's a total genius!

text_block_list.name: Almond Eye
text_block_list.text:
It's true.
So show it to me with your own two eyes!

text_block_list.name: Fusaichi Pandora
text_block_list.text: ...It's all thanks to Almond-chan, isn't it?

text_block_list.name: Fusaichi Pandora
text_block_list.text:
"My dream is gone now.
Because I learned that ideals and reality are two different things."

text_block_list.name: Fusaichi Pandora
text_block_list.text: Papa, Mama, Ku-chan-senpai... and Trainer. I'm truly sorry.

text_block_list.name: Fusaichi Pandora
text_block_list.text:
"I can't take a single step toward my dream anymore.
Even so—"

text_block_list.name: Fusaichi Pandora
text_block_list.text: What if it's for Ai-chan, though?

text_block_list.name: Fusaichi Pandora
text_block_list.text:
If it's to make those sparkling eyes
sparkle even brighter—

text_block_list.name: Fusaichi Pandora
text_block_list.text: ...I still wanna keep running.

text_block_list.name: Fusaichi Pandora
text_block_list.text:
(No matter how tough, how painful, or how impossible it gets,
I know I can push through.)

text_block_list.name: Fusaichi Pandora
text_block_list.text: (...Just like today.)

text_block_list.name: Fusaichi Pandora
text_block_list.text: I have a favor to ask...!

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
The day after the Queen Elizabeth II Cup.
Fusaichi Pandora came to the Trainer's office with an unusually formal air.

text_block_list.name: Fusaichi Pandora
text_block_list.text: From now on... I want to keep winning GⅠ races for Ai-chan's sake.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
I knew she was quite devoted to Almond Eye, but...
To think it would lead her to make such a decision.
choice_data_list: ...First off, why did you think that?
...First off, what made you think that?

text_block_list.name: Fusaichi Pandora
text_block_list.text: Even after running in the Shuka Sho, I only kept running because my Trainer stopped me from quitting, but...

text_block_list.name: Fusaichi Pandora
text_block_list.text:
TBH, deep down inside,
I couldn't shake the feeling that it was totally impossible.

text_block_list.name: Fusaichi Pandora
text_block_list.text:
Man, it got to the point where even running felt exhausting.
I could've quit anytime. Butââ

text_block_list.name: Fusaichi Pandora
text_block_list.text:
Ever since I met Ai-chan,
all of that just flew right out the window.

text_block_list.name: Fusaichi Pandora
text_block_list.text: ...The world became brighter.

text_block_list.name: Fusaichi Pandora
text_block_list.text:
"I can't run for my own sake anymore.
But if it's for Ai-chan—"

text_block_list.name: Fusaichi Pandora
text_block_list.text:
If it's to make Ai-chan's future shine brighter,
I can run. ...I want to run.

text_block_list.name: Fusaichi Pandora
text_block_list.text:
—I totally get that this is super rude.
I mean, Trainer, you knew all about my dream and supported me the whole time.

text_block_list.name: Fusaichi Pandora
text_block_list.text:
So――i-if you really hate it……
um……t-terminate the contract!

text_block_list.name: Fusaichi Pandora
text_block_list.text:
"I know it's selfish of me to do this.
But I couldn't think of any other way
to properly settle things. ...I'm sorry."

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text: Indeed, up until now, we had dedicated ourselves to daily training toward her dream: "To win tons of GⅠs and shine brighter than anyone in the world."

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
However, I signed a contract with Fusaichi Pandora in the first place
because I was drawn to her sheer genius.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Even if her reason to run shifts toward Almond Eye,
as long as she keeps running,
she ought to be able to shine brighter than anyone.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Being able to do it if it's for Almond Eye's sake
is something I understand precisely
because I watched from her side.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Her training paid off dramatically,
putting her in peak condition. And so, on the grand stage,
she conquered the Queen Elizabeth II Cup.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text: "If the desire to do it 'for Almond Eye' further develops her talent and brings glory to her future—"

text_block_list.name: Fusaichi Pandora
choice_data_list: Next, let's enter the Victoria Mile.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text: A GⅠ race where top-tier Tiara Umamusume of the Senior Class gather. If she wins, she'll be able to serve as a role model for Almond Eye, just like this time.

text_block_list.name: Fusaichi Pandora
text_block_list.text: ...F-For real? Is it really, truly okay?

text_block_list.name: Fusaichi Pandora
text_block_list.text:
Even though I'm
talking absolute nonsense—
choice_data_list: If your future shines bright, that's all I need.
As long as your future shines bright, that's all that matters.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Could this perhaps be...
somewhat similar to the feelings she holds for Almond Eye?

text_block_list.name: Fusaichi Pandora
text_block_list.text: "My" future is...

text_block_list.name: Fusaichi Pandora
text_block_list.text:
"If it's to make Ai-chan's future shine brighter,
I can run. ...I want to run."

text_block_list.name: Air Messiah
text_block_list.text:
However, I wonder if the compassion and affection
in my heart... might actually be close to "parental love."

text_block_list.name: Fusaichi Pandora
text_block_list.text: ...I see...

text_block_list.name: Fusaichi Pandora
text_block_list.text:
...Trainer,
so this is how you've felt the whole time.

text_block_list.name: Fusaichi Pandora
text_block_list.text: (I stopped caring about myself for a moment, because I just couldn't leave that girl alone.)

text_block_list.name: Fusaichi Pandora
text_block_list.text:
(That feeling of being able to push through
if it's for her sake...)

text_block_list.name: Fusaichi Pandora
text_block_list.text:
…………
Thanks, Trainer.

text_block_list.name: Fusaichi Pandora
text_block_list.text: (Just like Trainer, I want to help nurture Ai-chan's future too.)

text_block_list.name: Fusaichi Pandora
text_block_list.text:
(Because that was something so joyful
and so very kind.)

text_block_list.name: Fusaichi Pandora
text_block_list.text:
(Whether through meals, shoes, cheering—
or GⅠ victories, in all kinds of ways...!)

text_block_list.name: Fusaichi Pandora
text_block_list.text: Ah... um, well—

text_block_list.name: Fusaichi Pandora
text_block_list.text:
A-Anyway, for now!
I just want to win the Victoria Mile!
choice_data_list: Yeah, let's give it our best together again!
Yeah, let's keep working hard together!

text_block_list.name: Fusaichi Pandora
text_block_list.text:
Yeah...!
...Next time for sure, I'll make our dream come true!

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
――
And so that dream ended, and a new one began.

text_block_list.name: Fusaichi Pandora
text_block_list.text: Hoo, hoo...!

text_block_list.name: Fusaichi Pandora
text_block_list.text: Hell yeah, I'm off!

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
—Aiming for the spring "Victoria Mile,"
the days of the two of them running side-by-side began.
